headline: Brent Crude Edges Up to $92.93 Amid Middle East Supply Risks
summary: Brent crude oil futures rose 0.5% to $92.93 a barrel as traders evaluated Middle East security threats against ample global supply buffers.
why: Brent crude is the international benchmark for physical petroleum trading, influencing energy equities and global transport costs.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical tensions in the Persian Gulf raised risk premiums on global crude futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heightened risk premiums linked to Persian Gulf security incidents lifted Brent crude oil prices.
